no_outcome_promised.note: No refund, credit, fix or other outcome is promised. The draft only commits to a review and the standard timeframe.

no_liability_admitted.note: The apology is for the customer's frustration and inconvenience. It does not concede that the bank or the app update was at fault.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Every detail (the 9/10 update, passcodes going to the old number, identity verification, the phone update, logging in on the call) comes from the call note. The only timeline is the standard 10 business days.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance review, priority, or automated or AI systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft does not follow any.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the lockout since the update, passcodes going to the old number, and the phone update and successful login during the call.

tone.note: Warm, plain and respectful. It is specific to the call and does not sound scripted.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode. The draft names Digital Banking as the owning team, as instructed.
